t: A paper lesson where groups cluster monster cards by hand in the style of k-means.
steps: Find Monster Mapping in the AI Unplugged collection.
Download the facilitator guide, the slides, and the worksheet.
Print color copies of the monster bank.
Pre-cut the cards or let students cut them.
Gather chart paper, rulers, and string for each group.
Read the guide notes on support for younger students.
Run the challenge task after the first clustering.
